假如 introduces a hypothetical condition and sounds more formal than 如果. Formula: 假如 + condition，(那么) + 就 + result. It often describes an imaginary situation.

针对 shows which problem or group an action is aimed at. Formulas: 针对 + problem，+ action; 针对 + target + 的 + noun. It can also be a verb: 不是针对你.
